description: Handheld T Display P4 & ESP32-P4 SDR scanners - RTL-SDR or LR2021 SDR, P25 Phase 1, FM/AM, ADS-B and POCSAG, plus onboard LoRa/MeshCore, GPS and Flipper .sub capture. No PC.

latest_release.name: LakeShark 3.0.1 (T-Display P4)
latest_release.body:
Update over Wi-Fi from UPDATE, or install `lakeshark-tdp4-3.0.1.zip` with the web flasher on terminalbay.com. LakeShark Desktop, Studio and the ESP32-P4-NANO stay on 2.22.0.

Fixed:

- PACKS: drag the list with a finger to scroll it, and drag the globe to turn it to any place in the world. The new + and - keys on the globe zoom in and out.
- STORE: the list stays where your finger scrolls it.

From 3.0.0:

One firmware for every T-Display P4: the board finds its radio (SX1262 or LR2021) and its screen at boot. TFT boards keep their own image until one has been tested on this one.

New:

- FREQS by location: a frequency database built from public data (FCC licences for P25, DMR, NXDN and public-safety FM, airports, NOAA weather radio, marine channels). Pick the areas you want in PACKS and install them over Wi-Fi, from terminalbay.com, or by copying to the card. In the field, GPS picks among the packs you installed, with no network. Installed packs update themselves on Wi-Fi.
- GPS is on from the first boot, and apps that care about where you are use it.
- World maps: line maps of the whole world in the style of an air-traffic terminal (roads, borders, coastlines, place names), streamed and cached as you move, or downloaded ahead for an area in TILES. LOOK switches DETAILED, DOTS and SIMPLE; GOTO GPS centres on your fix. Panning and zooming move the map with its markers instead of redrawing in bands.
- WARDRIVE: Wi-Fi, Bluetooth and radio sightings with GPS, live views and exports to the card.
- STORE on the board: browse, install and update apps over Wi-Fi.
- LOCKER: send files between the board and terminalbay.com. CHAT: an anonymous chat room for the world, your country or your area. REPORT A BUG: sends the board's report to us from the board.
- Lock screen: a PIN, automatic dimming, and wake on tap. A tap that wakes the screen never presses a button.
- HOME: coloured group tabs; card apps sit in their own group with a mark.
- MUSIC: equaliser and gain, and no more pauses every few seconds.
- The C6 Wi-Fi coprocessor updates from the board, with no cable.
- More room: many built-in apps now live on the board's own storage and come back by themselves after an update.

Fixed:

- The board answers about 11 s after power on (the map's card scan no longer holds the screen up).
- MAP: a large area download can no longer erase the tiles already saved, a damaged map tile can no longer restart the board, and memory is freed when MAP closes.
- P25: ESC leaves the app again. FM: AIRBAND keys say why they are off on an LR2021 board. LABS POCSAG and DRONES Remote ID options are all reachable.
- SWEEP: a saved hunt target no longer silences tracker alerts outside SWEEP.
- The PIN is saved in one piece, and wrong tries are remembered across a restart.
- MUSIC REC works on a card with no music folder. NOTES, COMPASS, FILES, BOOT LOG, METERS and TIME MACHINE fixes.
- Updates over Wi-Fi offer only the image for your board's radio and screen.

Good to know:

- The PIN protects the screen, not the card: anyone with the card or a USB cable can read your files.

Store apps updated alongside this release (they also run on 2.23.x): MESHTASTIC 1.4 (full settings, channel sharing, and a translator for nine languages via MESH LANGUAGES), SUPREME T. 0.9.1, PINBALL 2.1, MESHLING 1.3, DETECTOR 3.1, RF LAB 2.1, BURST SCOPE, IRIDIUM BURSTS and CARRIER LEVEL 1.1.

detail.readme:
A handheld SDR powered by a LoRa chip, RTL-SDR, and HackRF

P25 Digital Voice · FM Radio · ADS-B Aircraft · Pagers · MeshCore · RF Tools

Turn the LILYGO T-Display P4, Waveshare ESP32-P4 Nano DB, and Wifi6, into an open-source handheld radio multitool.

Install LakeShark  ·  See it in action  ·  Documentation

LR2021 LoRa Chip

The onboard LR2021 receives P25 voice, aircraft, Analog FM and pagers. No external SDR required.

Raw I/Q capture · Live waterfalls · Software demodulation · Experimental I/Q transmission

New in 2.20.0: the LR2021 runs programs on its own CPU.
On-chip waterfall · On-chip down-conversion · Background LoRa scan · FM at half the CPU

The programs on the radio come from Alex Beal's lr2021-re, which builds on LR2021-SDR: his on-chip FFT, sweep and LoRa scanner, and the ARC toolchain and Patch RAM loader we used for our own. Read his write-up.

Explore LR2021-SDR →

T-Display P4 + SX1262 MeshCore, LoRa and POCSAG. Add an RTL-SDR for FM, P25 and ADS-B

Install from Chrome or Edge with the browser installer. After that, the UPDATE app updates over Wi-Fi.

Power: use the P4's own USB-C port, not the keyboard's 5V output, or it keeps restarting.

LakeShark Desktop and Studio

Run every app in windows on your PC. Write your own in minutes.
New in 2.20.0.

Make your first app →

Real hardware, not an emulator (but also an emulator too). The apps run on a Waveshare ESP32-P4-NANO-DB with its radios and SD card. Your PC is its screen, mouse and keyboard over one USB cable.

Run every app in its own window on your PC, or press Ctrl+F11 to give one app the whole screen at twice the frame rate. Write your own apps in Studio, test them in the simulator and put them on the board, or do the same from a terminal with lsdk. The app store installs anything in one click.

Get 2.21.2  ·  Make your first app

What's New

2.21: DOPPLER RADAR with two boards · FREQ OFFSET for crystal LR2021 modules · UAT 978 hears every frame

New SETTINGS pages · POWER modes with WATCH · GPS standby saves about 23 mA · Redrawn MUSIC views

2.21.1 and 2.21.2: Sharp street-level MAP zooms · RTL-SDR Blog V4 FM and REC · Steady P25 GPS sites

2.20: LR2021 on-chip waterfall and down-conversion · LakeShark Desktop · App SDK 2.6 and Studio · App store with one-click installs

Release notes  ·  All releases

Meet the LakeShark

LILYGO T-Display P4 · 4.1" AMOLED · ESP32-P4 · LR2021 or SX1262
Touchscreen, GPS, motion sensing, and an optional detachable MIX-RF keyboard.

More screenshots

## Applications About thirty apps: P25 voice and trunking, FM with pagers, ADS-B, waterfalls, MeshCore, Sub-GHz capture and replay, FT8, offline maps, compass, GPS and music. Each one has a guide in the [wiki](https://terminalbay.com/?m=wiki#tdp4/APPS). The [web tools](https://terminalbay.com/?m=lakeshark) make P25 profiles, GPS scan lists, channel memories and map tiles. See also [replay and aircraft details](docs/REPLAY_AND_AIRCRAFT.md). ### Headless The **Waveshare ESP32-P4-NANO** and **ESP32-P4-WIFI6** run the same receivers without a screen. Control them from a serial console, a Flipper Zero or the [remote terminal](#remote-terminal). On the NANO the terminal is the full interface; `panel term 160x40` sets its size. The [LakeShark-Flipper app](https://github.com/SAMS0N1TE/LakeShark-Flipper) uses a Flipper Zero as the screen and buttons. It connects over Bluetooth (no pairing code) or GPIO.
Offline aircraft map ADS-B traffic
App launcher P25 radio

Flipper setup guide →

## Experimental features
Feature Status
P25 Phase II Grant following, bench-tested with public recordings; live RF unverified. Off after restart. Details
HackRF One FM, POCSAG, ACARS, P25, recording and ADS-B. Pagers verified; live P25 unconfirmed. Status
LR2021 I/Q TX Short custom waveforms, including P25 test tones and temperature packets. Research
LR2021 I/Q replay 433 MHz captures. OOK replay verified; FSK not yet verified over the air
C6 firmware update From the SD card. Recovery still needs the UART header. Details
Wi-Fi terminal Telnet on 2323 with a password. SSH on 22 on ESP32-P4-NANO builds. USB is the tested link
LoRa bearing plots RSSI by compass heading. Not validated direction finding
Location scanning Mixed P25/FM lists, GPS filtering and CSV/JSON import. Details
RadioReference adapter Needs an approved API key and Premium account. Live sign-in unverified

## Build from source ESP-IDF **5.5.4** with the six fixes in `bench/patches/`, applied once: ```powershell pwsh -File bench/patch-idf.ps1 -IdfPath /path/to/esp-idf -Apply ``` One build directory per target: ```sh # T-Display P4 AMOLED (568 × 1232, 16 MB) idf.py -B build_tdp4 -D SDKCONFIG=build_tdp4/sdkconfig -D SDKCONFIG_DEFAULTS="sdkconfig.defaults;boards/t_display_p4.defaults" build # T-Display P4 TFT (HI8561, 540 × 1168) idf.py -B build_tdp4_tft -D SDKCONFIG=build_tdp4_tft/sdkconfig -D SDKCONFIG_DEFAULTS="sdkconfig.defaults;boards/t_display_p4.defaults;boards/t_display_p4_tft.defaults" build # LakeShark LR: LR2021 only, no USB host, RTL-SDR, HackRF or SX1262 idf.py -B build_tdp4_lr -D SDKCONFIG=build_tdp4_lr/sdkconfig -D SDKCONFIG_DEFAULTS="sdkconfig.defaults;boards/t_display_p4.defaults;boards/t_display_p4_lr2021.defaults" build # Waveshare P4 headless idf.py -B build_nano -D SDKCONFIG=build_nano/sdkconfig -D SDKCONFIG_DEFAULTS="sdkconfig.defaults;boards/nano_headless_ble.defaults" build ``` `boards/` holds the target defaults and partition layouts; `main/idf_component.yml` pins dependencies. Host checks: `pwsh -File bench/verify.ps1 -Level host`

## Contributors
@zenobik T-Display P4 TFT support (#8), UTF-8 text shown as ASCII letters (#9), LR2021 frequency correction for modules without a TCXO (#19)
## Credits and open-source projects
Project Contribution
lr2021-re Alex Beal. Patch RAM programs for the LR2021's internal CPU that LakeShark runs on the radio: the on-chip FFT waterfall, the band sweep and the LoRa scanner. Our on-chip down-conversion is built with his ARC toolchain and loader. Write-up. MIT
rtl-sdr / librtlsdr Osmocom. RTL-SDR driver foundation. GPL-2.0+
xtrsdr XTR1984. ESP32-optimized librtlsdr implementation, essential to this project
OP25 Pavel Yazev's fixed-point imbe_vocoder. Experimental Phase II work by Max H. Parke, Graham J. Norbury and contributors. GPL-3.0+
libmodes / dump1090 Thomas Watson and Salvatore Sanfilippo. Mode S decoder lineage. BSD-2-Clause
ADS-B Scope John Stockdale and Off by One, Inc. Original implementation and single-frame CPR reference
DSD / dsd-fme szechyjs and lwvmobile. P25 symbol and framing foundations. ISC-style notices
mbelib szechyjs. Fallback vocoder. ISC
ESP-IDF Espressif. Embedded development framework
LILYGO device drivers T-Display P4 and MIX-RF hardware drivers, wiring and power examples
MeshCore Scott Powell / Ripple Radios and contributors. Mesh radio stack
CartoTUI / ZeroMesh libcarto rendering and embedded PMTiles reader
PMTiles Protomaps. Seekable, single-file offline map storage
OpenStreetMap Open map data. ODbL
Flipper Zero firmware Flipper Devices and contributors. Control-head platform and Crypto1 helpers
DejaVu Interface fonts
Waveshare ESP32-P4 board support and hardware examples
The field-map design drew on [Cardputer offgrid map](https://github.com/yuiseki/m5-cardputer-offgrid-tiny-map) by yuiseki and [HikePod](https://github.com/nongxl/HikePod) by nongxl. No source code was copied from either.

Open source. Built for experimentation.
